stages.title: Prologue, Chapters 1-2 & Hard Missable
stages.summary: Establish Jason and Lucia's partnership across the Keys and southern districts. Crucially, complete the hard-missable balcony meditation at Jason's house with Lucia immediately after Down to Earth in Chapter 1 before moving to Chapter 2.

stages.title: Chapters 3-5 Story Campaign & Key Unlocks
stages.summary: Relocate the criminal enterprise to Vice City, execute cartel heists, complete Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, and complete That's Where The Money Is... to unlock Bank Vaults. Maintain 15 rolling manual saves.

stages.title: 100% Checklist & Specialist Grinds
stages.summary: Complete the post-game 100% checklist: 42 gold medals at 14 shooting ranges, 250 stunt jumps/bridges, 42 Top Fun drone races, 100 WAiNK landmark scans, 15 card sets, 70 challenges, and stranger strands.

stages.title: Free-Roam Cleanup & Platinum Pop
stages.summary: Finish large cumulative counters: $250,000 money laundering through Yasmani, 8 garage properties, 500 choices made, $100,000 shopping spree, explore all 52 areas, and trigger the Platinum pop.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.cutoffAudit: UNMISSABLE PLATINUM CAPSTONE: Automatically triggers the moment your 54th trophy is unlocked. No standalone tasks required [PowerPyx, Push Square].
trophies.guide: The ultimate reward for conquering GTA VI. This platinum trophy pops automatically the moment your 54th trophy unlocks. There is no separate in-game task for this trophy itself. By following this 4-stage roadmap—clearing the story, locking in the Chapter 1 missable meditation, completing the 100% checklist, and mopping up cumulative totals—you will earn this naturally as your final achievement.
steps: Follow Stage 1 through Stage 4 systematically, ensuring no early-game cutoffs are skipped [PowerPyx].
Prioritize the Chapter 1 balcony meditation early to protect the 100% save file [Game-Checklists].
Work through the 100% completion checklist post-story with the help of rolling manual saves [GTABase].
Clean up remaining cumulative trophies including money laundering and vehicle registrations [Mobalytics].
Watch the platinum trophy pop immediately upon earning the 54th trophy in your tracker [Push Square].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.cutoffAudit: CRITICAL HARD MISSABLE (CHAPTER 1 BALCONY CUTOFF): 18 meditations across 10 spots (doing with both Jason and Lucia counts +2; 15 needed for 100%, all 18 for trophy). The very first meditation spot on the balcony at Jason's house with Lucia immediately after Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth is permanently missable if skipped before leaving Chapter 1 [PowerPyx, GamesRadar, Game-Checklists, ViceBoard, KnowGTA6].
trophies.guide: THE ONLY PERMANENT MISSABLE TROPHY IN GTA VI. There are 10 distinct physical meditation spots across Leonida, providing 18 total meditation opportunities because meditating with both Jason and Lucia awards +2 count points at joint spots. CRITICAL CUTOFF WARNING: The first meditation spot on the second-floor balcony of Jason's safehouse with Lucia immediately following the Chapter 1 mission 'Down to Earth' becomes permanently inaccessible once Chapter 1 ends. If you miss it, you must replay the entire campaign from scratch! The remaining 9 spots can be completed at your leisure.
steps: CRITICAL: Immediately after Chapter 1 mission 'Down to Earth', walk onto the balcony of Jason's safehouse with Lucia and press the prompt to meditate [PowerPyx_meditations, GameChecklists].
Verify your PSN counter updates to 2/18 after completing this joint balcony session [GamesRadar].
Note that 15 meditations are needed for 100% completion, but all 18 are required for this trophy [ViceBoard].
Visit the remaining 9 outdoor meditation spots scattered along beaches, cliffs, and botanical gardens [KnowGTA6].
Complete both solo and partner meditations at each spot to reach the 18/18 counter target [PSNProfiles].
